blocks.text: ROXAS, Isabela — An 8-year-old boy died and five others, including his 85-year-old grandmother, were injured when an alleged improvised explosive device (IED) detonated in Sitio Raniag, Barangay Sinamar, on Sunday morning, authorities said. According to the police, the boy’s grandmother and three other minors, all residents of the village, were wounded in the explosion. They were brought to the Manuel A. Roxas District Hospital for treatment. Witnesses said they heard a loud explosion and later saw the victims lying on the ground. The boy, a Grade 3 pupil who sustained serious injuries, was declared dead on arrival at the hospital. […]... Keep on reading: Boy dies, 5 hurt in Isabela blast
